text: The owned style extraction lets configuration results and the confirmation template share form-selection and selection-grid structure. It replaces first/last paragraph styling with explicit title/data and protocol-title/protocol-data classes, keeping the semantic display roles stable when nested badges are added. The historical badge rename recommended→info-badge is paired with markup and test updates; recommended-protocol still marks the selected recommendation, while addon/warning badge variants have separate display styles. Accepted later source uses badge and logical dimensions, so the historical names are not a new current naming rule. The owned confirmation question keeps default font size and the owned file set excludes shared widgets.css focus-ring changes. No wrapping, localization, zoom, focus-ring or contrast result was freshly verified.
title: Account Hub configuration styles use explicit data roles when sharing the confirmation layout
